prompts.title: Harden offline admission invariants
prompts.activation_gate: Only when this proposed companion contract is being prepared for executable use; coordinate with any existing hardening assignment.
prompts.prompt: Use implementation-blockers.json and offline-review.json to address all twelve demonstrated unsafe semantic mutations in an isolated candidate. Add positive controls for permitted private preservation, exact editions, mutable timestamp+hash snapshots and separately recorded historical/readback observations. Prove URI/date/date-time validation actually runs. Preserve historical submitted bytes. Do not acquire source bodies, touch live storage or collector state, publish, or label the eight acquisition cases executed.
prompts.stop_when: Each demonstrated gap has a documented rejecting check and valid positive control, or its exact remaining blocker is reported.

prompts.title: Verify bounded OpenAlex enumeration
prompts.activation_gate: A finite existing-qualified-source selection and shared request budget have been approved; no simultaneous provider workload.
prompts.prompt: Use the already verified official paging documentation to test only a small frozen selection, with per_page at most 100, exact corpus/filters and unique Work-ID accounting. Record cursor termination, duplicate/changed-page checks and complete receipts. Keep caches/manuscripts excluded. Do not repeat the singleton solely to reproduce its already matching metadata. Preserve source quotas, retry limits and uncertainty if the population changes.
prompts.stop_when: The finite selection is exhausted and reconciled, or the first unresolved access/completeness blocker is recorded.

prompts.title: Qualify permitted native-route evidence
prompts.activation_gate: New publisher-supported permitted-access evidence is available; no retry or evasion of a denied route.
prompts.prompt: For held MIT native workbooks and arXiv source containers only, inspect newly available official access evidence. Identify the exact supported route, version/snapshot binding, finite response limit and native-feature inventory requirements. Preserve historical denials and null origin status. Do not log in, use credentials or private storage, fetch manuscript/source/workbook bodies, bypass restrictions or infer server failure from a tool error. Obtain separate acquisition authority before any body retrieval.
prompts.stop_when: Sufficient permitted-route preflight evidence is documented, or the precise remaining access/rights/identity gap is recorded.

prompts.title: Reconcile later research integration
prompts.activation_gate: The single authorized repository writer selects this package for sequential integration after reviewing current-main drift.
prompts.prompt: Prepare an additive research-only integration on the then-current verified base. Carry all eight submitted deliverables and the issued-assignment provenance through their manifest and review addenda. Register source corrections, holds and bounded followups without changing operational collector gates or independent-study totals. Reuse the already reconciled v3 archive identity; do not reread or redownload it solely for identity. If metadata destination presence matters, verify it only through an already authorized storage route; a local research body is not proof of durable collection presence. Run repository aggregate checks and independent review before publication under the parent workflow.
prompts.stop_when: A reviewed additive candidate and exact remaining integration blocker are reported; publication or live mutation remains outside this prompt.
